# fastcflare

> Complete access to the Cloudflare SDK

## Modules

- `fastcflare.skill`: Cloudflare API access via `CloudflareApi`: zones, DNS records, API tokens, caching, and every other Cloudflare v4 feature from Python. Use this for day-to-day Cloudflare work instead of hand-built httpx calls against api.cloudflare.com.
